bullets.text: Commercial Lines combined ratio improved 4.3 points to 84.1; Property combined ratio was 143.6; Personal Lines profitability stayed strong despite over $1 billion in personal auto policyholder credits.
Auto PIFs +11% YOY to add over 1.5M policies, aided by Apron Relief; Property PIFs +13%; special lines PIFs +6%; Q2 new auto applications fell 4% alongside flat total quotes.

Property CR included 54.3 pts from 20 declared industry catastrophe events plus unfavorable first-quarter storm development; losses remained below the $375M aggregate excess of loss reinsurance retention threshold through June.

Auto claims frequency and miles driven remained down versus 2019; incoming commercial auto claim counts moved toward pre-COVID levels as the quarter progressed, especially in less disrupted trucking market targets.
Direct channel recovery materially outpaced Agency, partly due to agent social distancing compliance; Direct auto quotes rose 6% YOY; direct commercial auto sales grew 4% and BQX sales grew 36%.

Company expanded investments in its Diversity and Inclusion agenda, partnering with its African American ERG; employees participated in an allyship inclusion week, and the CEO highlighted opportunities to increase leadership diversity.

Implemented higher deductibles or ACV requirements for wind/hail coverage in six additional states (16 total); restructured auto product and rates for Michigan PIP reform; deployed auto product model 8.6 into five states.

Property net premiums written rose 12% YOY (13% YTD); June new home and condo applications grew 6%; transportation network company NPW was reduced by $29.0 million to calibrate to lower ridesharing usage.

Property 4.0 deployed to seven more states (18 active); HQX Buy mobile launched in 17 states; Portfolio quoting added four states (37 active); BOP 1.2 developed for September release across new states.

Investment portfolio generated a 4.5% total return in Q2, with strongest performance in equities; conservative positioning was maintained amid uncertainty, after adding attractive investments as valuations improved in several sectors.
